title: Hinomori Shizuku — Trial Skin Care Routine〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, I've finished filling out that skincare product survey you put together for the stream!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm also done!
Did I answer appropriately?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much!
I'll need a second to see what you wrote.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you both for being so thorough. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Haruka also filled it out...
So, it might be time for my trial run.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means you're actually gonna try some skincare products that are currently trending, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, my plan is to divide them into two sets to simplify things for everyone watching. One for lighter products that absorb quickly, and another for heavier, more moisturizing products.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, while shooting that commercial, one of the company's representatives gave me samples of their products. I'll be trying those out as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, great idea! They're definitely gonna love it if you bring those up during the stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... This is a set of lighter products...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And this is a set of more moisture-oriented products. And there's also the samples I received during the shoot...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But which should I try first...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, they said these samples are from their new line.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Since they were kind enough to give me these, I think I'll try them out today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You seem so sparkly for some reason today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi! Saito!
Doesn't Shizuku seem really sparkly for some reason today?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I mean, what's gotten into you?
You hardly ever put on this much makeup when you're not scheduled to do a shoot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You see, I started trying some skincare products yesterday in preparation for that stream idea.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I decided to try some of the samples I received while shooting that commercial, and I noticed that my makeup was applying so much more smoothly. One thing led to another...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I ended up going all out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's understandable.
Makeup is so much more fun when your skin cooperates like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly! Oh, I actually brought some for all of you to try. Here you are, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you're already dazzling on a daily basis, Shizuku. If this stuff made you look even more amazing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What's gonna happen when I use it?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Actually, is it even okay for someone like me to use these products? It might change me to the point of being unrecognizable...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not so sure about that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it is always fun to try something that you normally don't.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I hope our viewers get to have just as much fun when they watch.
